subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk start whenever OpenAI Realtime can be auto-selected from API-key/OAuth/Codex auth, or only after an explicit realtime readiness/preflight says the provider is intended and usable for this session?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally allow implicit OpenAI/Codex fallback, while this report expects a local/non-Realtime Talk setup not to start OpenAI Realtime; either choice changes user-facing setup and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Gate on Gateway readiness
options.body: Disable or block the browser Talk start before microphone access unless talk.catalog/readiness reports a usable intended realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

options.title: Keep implicit credential activation
options.body: Treat configured OpenAI/Codex realtime auth as sufficient and limit follow-up work to clearer diagnostics for provider or API failures.

options.title: Require explicit realtime config
options.body: Only show or start browser Talk when talk.realtime is explicitly configured, accepting any migration or upgrade impact for current users relying on auto-selection.

recommendation.title: Gate on Gateway readiness
recommendation.body: Disable or block the browser Talk start before microphone access unless talk.catalog/readiness reports a usable intended realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The current OpenAI/Codex fallback and Control UI Talk docs are closest to steipete's recent merged work and current-main blame.
